items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: I was just talking to Jimmy Heath the other day and you know we were laughing and talking about the cost of things.

ctx.x: You know but this occurs to me, and it seems like one of the things that keeps getting cheaper and cheaper to the point of being ridiculous is buying music.

Well that’s ‘cause musicians aren’t making any money. I was just talking to Jimmy Heath the other day and you know we were laughing and talking about the cost of things. And I said yeah everything is going up but what — jazz musicians have been making the same amount of money since I came along. I mean I’m talking to Jimmy Heath who is like 88 or something. And I said I’ve been here at least 30 years myself. The pay hasn’t changed. I mean the garbage man pay has gone up. You know what I mean? But most of the jazz…
